title: [release-1.25] Bump x/sys to v0.50.0, Skopeo to v1.25.2
body:
Bump golang.org/x/sys to v0.50.0, and then Skopeo to v1.25.2.

This addresses a SIGSEV issue on ppc64le as reported in https://github.com/podman-container-tools/skopeo/issues/3041
